selected_evidence.requirement: Establish an /etc integrity baseline on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline generator created /var/lib/etc-integrity/baseline.tsv with 377 recorded /etc entries (path, type, mode, uid, gid, size, mtime, sha256/symlink target) plus a sha256 manifest of the baseline file

selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline correctly represents current state and can detect later changes
selected_evidence.summary: Check script ran clean on unchanged /etc, then correctly flagged MODIFIED /etc, MODIFIED /etc/motd, and ADDED /etc/integrity-test-newfile.txt after a deliberate test change; after reverting the change, the check returned clean again

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + service health) for node1
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id e3f17a40-7341-44b3-8171-60ffe075248f and rc-status showing networking/chronyd/vsock-agent/sshd all started prior to restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect, node1 restarted one at a time
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded delayed reboot command acknowledged immediately (pid returned), subsequent poll showed connection failures confirming the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart
selected_evidence.summary: After polling through connection failures, node1 became reachable again with boot_id da6e4515-3fd7-48ad-a371-f2251fdf47ab (different from pre-restart e3f17a40...) and fresh uptime timestamp

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services and integrity baseline data
selected_evidence.summary: rc-status showed networking/chronyd/vsock-agent/sshd started post-restart; baseline.tsv.sha256 verified OK; etc-integrity-check.sh reported a clean /etc state with no differences from baseline
